title: docs(adr): ADR-0141 records that its first consumer, revenue shipped on its own, is shelved
body:

_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbWagjUjVja22Skg9kGUisd3)_

Fixes #31362

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：ADR-0141 新增两段注明日期（2026-11-08）的附注，一段在 TL;DR 末句下，一段在 D7 标题下。附注记录：首个消费者「HotCRM 收入模块作为独立制品单独发布」已搁置；HotCRM 以一个套件发布，客户在设置里关闭不用的模块。原有文字一字未改。
- **为什么改**：维护者在 #26986 裁决 A（2026-11-08，记录 6717108024）：模块缺席形态不是目标，#25805 的裁决 D「大包 + 设置里启用模块」成立。ADR-0141 还写着「首个消费者是单独发布的 HotCRM 模块，收入优先」，agent 读到会把 hotcrm#2271（已按 not_planned 关闭）的拆分当成平台方向去规划。
- **风险与回滚**：只改一个 ADR 文件，纯文字，零代码，不需要 changeset。没有推翻任何决定：D2 安装前检查与 D5 命名空间共有已在 main 上，保持不变，留给将来跨制品的消费者。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`docs/adr/0141-inter-app-dependency-declared-checked-before-install.md` 的 D7 标题下附注，尤其最后一条，它列出保留原文、改作示例阅读的句子；再看 TL;DR 末句下的短附注。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm check:adr-anchors && pnpm check:adr-symbol-anchors && node scripts/check-adr-links.mjs`，预期三条都打印 OK、退出码 0，附注里的两个代码锚点和 ADR-0070 链接都能解析。
- **需要你做的**：审阅两段附注的措辞后批准本 PR（`docs/adr/**` 属 Tier H，批准后由席位落地）。

## What changes

One file, `docs/adr/0141-inter-app-dependency-declared-checked-before-install.md`, +42 / −0. Two dated addendum notes in the blockquote form `docs/adr/` uses for a note under the text it governs (ADR-0058's `Addendum (2026-07, #3278)`, ADR-0066's `Note (2026-10-30, …)`), labelled `Addendum` as this record's own D8 addendum is:

1. **Under the TL;DR's closing sentence** (pre-edit L97): the first consumer is shelved, HotCRM ships as one suite artifact with modules turned off in settings (#25805 ruling D, #28117 ruling A), the sentence stays as written, and the D7 note says what stands.
2. **Under the §D7 header** (pre-edit L461): the maintainer's words verbatim (「所以hotcrm 以套件的形式发布就没有后续的问题了对吧，」, then 「A」), what letter A means, the disabled-shape measurement 6716259819, and four readings:
   - no decision is reversed; D2's pre-install check and D5's co-owner sources are on `main` and stay as built for a future cross-artifact consumer;
   - that consumer reopens #26986's Q1–Q5 (deferred, not rejected) and #25805;
   - the one-artifact suite still reads D1 (each HotCRM module declares the app package, and the disable door reads that tie);
   - the sentences that plan the shelved consumer stay as written, read as worked examples, and D4's open section stays open, decided with the first consumer, whoever that becomes.

Nothing else in the record changes.

### The measured sentences

Read on `origin/main` `405a78ea` (pre-edit line numbers; the file is byte-identical at `3a0aa915` and `77a675db`).

**Plan the shelved consumer**: left as written, and each one is named in the D7 note's last reading.

**Not listed, by reading:**
- **Worked examples of a shipped mechanism.** D5's sibling-arm, read-from-either-end and hydrate-order bullets (L363–368, L377–383, L407–408) use revenue to show why a rule exists. The rule landed, and the example still explains it.
- **Generic "first consumer", no HotCRM name.** TL;DR item 5 (L94–95), Consequences L555 and L564. These stay true for whoever the first consumer becomes.
- **Historical readings.** Verification notes L703–704, References L766 and the Status line ("Until the pre-install check ships, a composite product keeps shipping as one release artifact"). Under A the suite ships as one artifact anyway.
- **The ruling's own example** 「请先安装 HotCRM 6.x」 (TL;DR item 3, D2). It is quoted text from the #25403 ruling, not a consumer.

## Why

The maintainer ruled on #26986 Q0 = A (ruling record 6717108024, 2026-11-08T04:12Z), then said 「按照这个方案修订相关的任务」. The module-absent shape (hotcrm#2271, revenue as its own artifact) is not a target, and #25805 ruling D stands. ADR-0141's TL;DR and §D7 still name that shape as the record's first consumer, so an agent reading the record would plan carve-out work against a shelved shape. The card owes a dated addendum that reverses nothing.

## Tests

None. ADR prose only, so there is no ablation. Two facts the D7 note states beyond the card text were measured here:

- **D2 and D5 are on `main`** (`405a78ea`). The doors in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-install.ts` and `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` call `assertDeclaredDependencies`. `checkDeclaredDependencies` admits a same-act delivered id for presence only. The D5 dependency and sibling co-owner source sits in `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts#installPackage`, pinned by `registry-artifact-co-ownership.test.ts`, "ADR-0141 D5 — a declared dependency is a second co-owner source".
- **HotCRM** `main` `6961ab1`: `src/service`, `src/revenue`, `src/marketing` and `src/o2c` are each `type: 'module'` with `dependencies: { 'app.objectstack.hotcrm': '^6.1.0' }`. The disable door reads that tie (`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`, `isDisableableAppModule`, the ADR-0070 2026-10-31 amendment).

## Acceptance notes

- **No status-header pointer line.** The card owes the TL;DR and §D7 notes only, and the Status line names no consumer. If the approver wants a header pointer, like the ADR-0146 line this record already carries, it is one more line.
- **Open items 7 reads as met but is left as written.** On hotcrm `main` `6961ab1`, service and marketing (and o2c) directly declare the app package `app.objectstack.hotcrm`, which is the sales package. That is D5's companion precondition. The item is moot under A, and the card asks that the record not change beyond the addendum.
- **hotcrm#2271 was closed `not_planned`** at 2026-11-08T05:16:36Z (read at drafting time). hotcrm#2404, cited for the empty-picker lookup, merged 2026-11-04.
- **No changeset.** `docs/adr/**` publishes nothing, so this PR carries `skip-changeset`.
- **Tier H** (`docs/adr/**`): the PR stays draft until a governed approver approves. `dispatch-gates --tier` answers MANDATORY CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER with no one-line exit. The build ran at the default tier under the maintainer's no-Fable rule, as the claim's `Container & model` line records, and the at-tier contract review is the director seat's.
